title: Agent Credential Hygiene for Splunk Agent Observability
dataSources: Agent source code and deployment configuration, scanned in CI for `SPLUNK_AO_*` usage and literal keys
description: Checks that agent code uses only ingest credentials from the environment and never holds Splunk Agent Observability console logins (`SPLUNK_AO_USER`, `SPLUNK_AO_PASSWORD`, `SPLUNK_AO_USER_ID`) or hardcoded keys.
value: Console logins in agent code give anyone with the code a person's access to every project they can see. Keeping them out limits a code leak to ingest rights.
implementation: In CI, fail the build when agent code references `SPLUNK_AO_USER`, `SPLUNK_AO_PASSWORD` or `SPLUNK_AO_USER_ID`, or contains a literal key. Supply `SPLUNK_AO_API_KEY` or `SPLUNK_AO_O11Y_TOKEN` from the deployment's secret store.
knownFalsePositives: Test fixtures that mention the variable names in documentation strings can match; scope the scan to runtime code.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites

A Splunk Agent Observability project for the application and one Agent Stream per environment or agent inside it. Do not create a second project for the same application: a second project splits the traces. The agent reads `SPLUNK_AO_PROJECT` and `SPLUNK_AO_AGENT_STREAM` from the environment. SaaS tenants authenticate with `SPLUNK_AO_REALM` and `SPLUNK_AO_O11Y_TOKEN`; on-prem tenants with `SPLUNK_AO_API_KEY` plus `SPLUNK_AO_CONSOLE_URL`. Install the SDK with `pip install splunk-ao` (`pip install "splunk-ao[langchain]"` for the LangChain callback).

Step 1 — Instrument the agent

`SPLUNK_AO_USER`, `SPLUNK_AO_PASSWORD` and `SPLUNK_AO_USER_ID` are console login. They do not route traces. Never put them in agent code, and never hardcode keys.

Step 2 — Configure in Splunk Agent Observability

Nothing to configure in the console. Issue ingest credentials per deployment and store them in the secret store.

Step 3 — Validate

Add a test change that references `SPLUNK_AO_PASSWORD` and confirm CI fails. This use case was written from the Splunk Agent Observability documentation without access to a tenant, so it ships as a draft. Confirm each step in the Splunk Agent Observability console before promoting it.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Run the check on every change to agent repositories.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

Traces stop after the change: the deployment has no ingest credential. Set `SPLUNK_AO_API_KEY` plus `SPLUNK_AO_CONSOLE_URL` (on-prem) or `SPLUNK_AO_REALM` plus `SPLUNK_AO_O11Y_TOKEN` (SaaS).
grandmaExplanation: We make sure the assistant's program never carries a person's password, only its own delivery pass kept in a safe.

productArtifacts.title: CI rule for Splunk Agent Observability credentials
productArtifacts.body:
Fail when runtime code references: SPLUNK_AO_USER, SPLUNK_AO_PASSWORD, SPLUNK_AO_USER_ID (console login only; they do not route traces)
Fail when runtime code contains a literal API key or token
Allow from the environment: SPLUNK_AO_PROJECT, SPLUNK_AO_AGENT_STREAM, SPLUNK_AO_API_KEY + SPLUNK_AO_CONSOLE_URL (on-prem), SPLUNK_AO_REALM + SPLUNK_AO_O11Y_TOKEN (SaaS)
Set SPLUNK_AO_API_URL only when deriving it from the console URL is wrong
